mapper.select: SELECT sdi.* FROM sys_dict_item sdi WHERE sdi.sys_dict_id IN (SELECT sd.sys_dict_id FROM sys_dict sd WHERE sd.sys_dict_status = 1 AND sd.sys_dict_code = #{sysDictCode})

SELECT sdi.* FROM sys_dict_item sdi WHERE sdi.sys_dict_id IN (SELECT sd.sys_dict_id FROM sys_dict sd WHERE sd.sys_dict_status = 1 AND sd.sys_dict_pid = #{sysDictId} OR sd.sys_dict_id = #{sysDictId}) ORDER BY sdi.sys_dict_item_sort, sdi.create_time DESC
